title: Review a prototype against product intent
statement: As a designer, I can connect feedback on a specific prototype element to the exact story revision it explores so later changes stay visible instead of silently moving the feedback.

acceptance_criteria.statement: After a local prototype revision is created, changing the original source directory does not change the stored revision.
An annotation can record a selector, prototype revision, and story revision before either endpoint resolves.
Composition reports an annotation as current, stale, or unresolved, and a changed endpoint never silently retargets it.
An external prototype is embeddable only when its URL origin exactly matches an explicit allowlist entry.
